decision_label: SIMPLE SUPERDIODE OP ABORTS IN THE 4-ReLU NETLIST
failure_mechanism: doAnalyses: OP: Timestep too small; trouble with xh1d:d_1n4148_1-instance d.xh1d.d1. UIC TRAN of the same netlist also failed to find an initial point. i(Vdd) during failed OP ~77 A (rail fight).
